scope.objective: Audit the exact reaction identity, direction, stereochemistry, and canonical pH 7.3 H+ coefficient for the named R1521 NAD(H) frontier reactions.
exclusions: No inference of zero H+ from an empty MetaNetX balance flag or an equation that omits H+
scope.h_coefficient_sign_convention: Positive means H+ is on the product side in the authoritative model reaction orientation; negative means H+ is on the reactant side; null means identity/pH evidence is insufficient and the reaction is a blocker.

rows.required_change: The exact KEGG/Rhea reaction supports two product H+ at pH 7.3 after the NAD(H) tuple migration; do not apply until the m280 acid-base identity is closed across copies.
rows.evidence_status: Rhea pH-7.3 reaction directly supports the named chemistry; the annotated MNXR uses MNXM736083/bigg aproa whereas model m280 is MNXM736082/bamppald, so the MNXR crosswalk is not an exact species match.
rows.limitations: Same biochemical skeleton but distinct MetaNetX acid-base species; identity closure is required before proton editing.

rows.evidence_status: Corrected identity directly supported; current MNXR annotation contradicted.
rows.limitations: MNXR190525 is a CoA-acetylating, ethanol/acetyl-CoA, two-NAD reaction and is not the source equation.

rows.limitations: MNXR131478/SABIO 12743 is an alcohol/aldehyde redox record and its product chemical is not model decanoate MNXM1043. No exact pH-7.3 source was opened in this bounded audit.
